## Docs-first check (no documentation debt)

Perch has a hard rule: **docs must never lag behind behaviour.** A PR that changes behaviour without bringing the relevant doc along is not mergeable. Leaving "I'll update the doc later" debt is treated as breaking the build.

- [ ] The relevant file in `docs/` has been updated in **this** PR to reflect this change, **or** this PR is docs-only, **or** the design was already accurately covered by an existing doc (cite which file/section).
- [ ] No "planned" / "will" language now describes something that has shipped — it has been rewritten in present tense.
- [ ] No doc contradicts the code introduced in this PR.
